new_libraries.name: LionFastLcd
new_libraries.author: leva <leva.the.lion@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Change-tracked, buffered character-LCD layer over LiquidCrystal_I2C.
new_libraries.paragraph: Keeps a RAM shadow of the display and pushes only the cells that actually changed, coalescing runs of consecutive cells into a single setCursor() to cut I2C traffic. Implements Arduino Print, so use print()/println() as usual. Supports stacked/overlay screens via Clone()/Activate()/Deactivate() with a z-order. The class is non-copyable and objects are created only through CreateMain()/Clone() (they register in a static list and are meant to live for the program's lifetime); call CreateMain() once before any Clone()/Activate(). The shadow buffer is cols*rows bytes. Depends on LionArray and marcoschwartz/LiquidCrystal_I2C. Optional scrolling of over-long lines is ESP8266-only and OFF by default: build with -DFLCD_LONG_MESSAGES and add leva/LionTask. ESP8266 + AVR.

new_libraries.name: Soldered-position-sensor-AS5600-breakout-Arduino-library
new_libraries.author: Soldered
new_libraries.sentence: Library for magnetic rotation sensor AS5600, compatible with EasyC and Arduino
new_libraries.paragraph: This is an Arduino library for the magnetic rotation sensor AS5600 breakout board from Soldered electronics. Use it to read a rotation of a magnet (suitable for magnetic rotary encoders), measure and detect magnetic fields and even generate analog or PWM signals based on the output.

new_libraries.name: WiStalker
new_libraries.author: 1e1
new_libraries.sentence: Passive 802.11 presence detection for the ESP8266 and ESP32.
new_libraries.paragraph: Puts the radio in promiscuous mode and reports the layer-2 addresses of every sniffed frame, so you can tell whether known devices are within range. The receive path is kept minimal: only the addresses needed for presence are extracted. One API, backed by the NONOS SDK on ESP8266 and ESP-IDF on ESP32.

library.name: ESP32IRPulseKit
library.author: TANAKA Masayuki
library.sentence: IR remote send/receive toolkit for ESP32 (Arduino Core 3.0+/ESP-IDF 5 RMT driver).
library.paragraph: Provides RAW tick capture, scoring-based decode candidate handling, and protocol-based send helpers designed for the ESP32 RMT driver, plus a separate air-conditioner layer (esp32irpk::ac) that decodes/encodes vendor state frames (Panasonic, Gree, Mitsubishi, Mitsubishi Heavy, Fujitsu, Daikin, Toshiba, Samsung, Sharp, Kelvinator, Midea, Carrier, Hitachi, Haier, TCL).

library.name: UARDECS Library
library.author: H.kurosaki,K.yasuba
library.sentence: A library that provides communication functions conforming to UECS, a common standard for horticulture in Japan.
library.paragraph: This library provides UDP server and Web server function conforming to UECS standard. It corresponds to Arduino UNO or MEGA. Always requires Ethernet shield2.

library.name: UARDECS_MEGA Library
library.author: H.kurosaki,K.yasuba
library.sentence: A library that provides communication functions conforming to UECS, a common standard for horticulture in Japan.
library.paragraph: This library provides UDP server and Web server function conforming to UECS standard. This is a high-performance version of UARDECS, and the setting items by the user are increasing greatly. It corresponds to Arduino MEGA. Arduino UNO can also be used, but there is not enough available memory. Always requires Ethernet shield2.
